findings.title: Duplicate check matches the pull request by number only, and also counts the hand-off chip that later gets swept
findings.body: `hasPullRequest` treats any chip whose `pullRequest.number` equals `detail.number` as the reference. That causes two problems. First, `buildPullRequestReferenceContext` keys its chip by URL because "repositories can share pull request numbers" (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:1138). If the composer already holds a reference to #42 in another repository, adding a remark from this #42 adds no reference for it, and the remark chip only says `PR #42 conversation` (logic.ts:1166). The agent ends up with the wrong repository's PR as context, and nothing tells the user. Second, `pullRequestContextComment` also sets `pullRequest` on the hand-off chip `pull-request-context:N` (logic.ts:1107, 1121). If that hand-off chip is what satisfies the check, the next hand-off removes it through `handoffReviewComments` (logic.ts:926-929). The user's `pr-comment:` chips stay, but nothing references their PR any more. Fix: compare on `existing.id === \`pr-reference:${detail.url}\`` (or on `pullRequest.url`) and skip ids in the `pull-request-` hand-off namespace.

findings.title: readableBody can return "" rather than null for a body that is only an unclosed `<!--`
findings.body: `visibleBody` only strips comments that are closed (logic.ts:517). A body like `<!-- bot state` with no `-->` therefore passes the `visibleBody(body) === null` guard. `readableBody` then drops everything after the unclosed `<!--` (lines 700-704) and returns `""`. In `buildPullRequestCommentContext` that empty string is not `null`, so the chip is built with text `octocat: ` and nothing else. The docstring says the function returns null for a body with no words. Return null when the joined result is empty, and the button gates in the tabs could use the same check.

findings.title: Summary-tab Add to chat sends only the first page of a thread's replies; the Code tab sends every loaded reply
findings.body: In `ReviewThreadCard`, Add to chat passes `{ ...thread, comments }` with every comment the reader has loaded (PullRequestReviewAnnotation.tsx:260), and the prop doc says so. The Summary tab passes `detail.reviewThreads`' thread as it is (here, and again in PullRequestDetailPanel.tsx:1065-1068). When a thread has more replies (`hasMoreReplies`, Summary tab line 664), the same action from the Summary tab silently leaves out the later replies. It is worth checking whether the replies loaded in the Summary tab can be merged in, or at least whether the behaviour should match the Code tab.

contracts.action: Add to chat on a PR remark or review thread adds a PR reference chip (once) plus a remark chip to the composer beside the panel
contracts.equivalent_path: ChatComposer's PR mention path (apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatComposer.tsx:1952) builds buildPullRequestReferenceContext; AnnotatableCodeView calls addReviewComment directly
contracts.before_after: addReviewComment removes any existing chip with the same id and places the inline reference at the caret through the insertion handler (composerDraftStore.ts:3755-3774), so adding the same remark twice replaces it instead of duplicating it. The PR-reference check matches on number, not URL, unlike the URL keying the reference builder uses (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:1138).
contracts.visible_effect: Chips appear in the composer and a success toast says "Added to the composer".
contracts.failure_mode: Synchronous store call; when the draft key does not resolve, addReviewComment returns without doing anything (composerDraftStore.ts:3757) but the toast still reports success. If the composer already holds a same-numbered PR from another repository, no reference to this PR is added.

contracts.action: Review thread context text now uses readableBody (HTML comments stripped outside fences) for the fix hand-offs too
contracts.equivalent_path: visibleBody (logic.ts:516) used before; it kept comment markup in the text
contracts.before_after: Fix-finding hand-offs now drop bot bookkeeping before the text is bounded to 1000 characters (logic.ts:819-824).
contracts.visible_effect: The agent receives the remark text without the HTML comments.
contracts.failure_mode: An unclosed `<!--` drops the rest of the body.

summary: This PR adds "Add to chat" to the Code, Summary and Timeline tabs. It brings a review remark or conversation into the composer beside the panel as a user chip (`pr-comment:`) that later hand-offs keep, plus a PR reference chip. It also strips bot HTML comments from the text sent to the agent. The main problem is the duplicate check in `addCommentToChat`: it matches the PR by number rather than URL, and it counts the hand-off chip that a later hand-off removes. Either way the remark chip can end up without the reference to its own PR. Two smaller points: `readableBody` returns an empty string for an unclosed `<!--`, and the Summary tab sends only the first page of a thread's replies while the Code tab sends every loaded reply.
